title: DRE schedules
description: The schedules file, `schedules.yml`: a list of named schedules.

schedule.description: One named schedule. DRE doesn't fire it; your orchestrator runs `dre run --schedule <name>`.

name.description: The schedule's name: letters, digits and `_`, not starting with a digit. Unique across the project.

report.description: The report to run. Use `report` or `select`, not both.

set.description: The Set of `report` to run. Only with `report`.

select.description: A selector for the reports to run, e.g. `tag:regulatory`. Use `report` or `select`, not both.

vars.description: Variables for the run: above the report's own and below `--var`.

timezone.description: The timezone `run.date` and `run.now` use, an IANA name such as `Australia/Sydney`. Default: UTC.

cron.description: A cron expression. A schedule needs exactly one of `cron`, `every` or `rrule`.

every.description: Every N days, weeks or months, with exactly one unit, e.g. `{days: 3}`.
